mapper.select: SELECT id, gym_id AS gymId, name, rows_count AS rowsCount, cols_count AS colsCount, total_count AS totalCount, display_order AS displayOrder FROM locker_zone WHERE gym_id = #{gymId} ORDER BY display_order ASC, id ASC
SELECT id, gym_id AS gymId, name, rows_count AS rowsCount, cols_count AS colsCount, total_count AS totalCount, display_order AS displayOrder FROM locker_zone WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO locker_zone (gym_id, name, rows_count, cols_count, total_count, display_order) VALUES (#{gymId}, #{name}, #{rowsCount}, #{colsCount}, #{totalCount}, #{displayOrder})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM locker WHERE zone_id = #{zoneId}
mapper.sql: SELECT l.id, l.zone_id AS zoneId, l.locker_number AS lockerNumber, lz.gym_id AS gymId, m.id AS membershipId, m.user_id AS memberId, up.name AS memberName, m.start_date AS startDate, m.end_date AS endDate FROM locker l JOIN locker_zone lz ON lz.id = l.zone_id LEFT JOIN membership m ON m.id = (SELECT MAX(m2.id) FROM membership m2 WHERE m2.locker_id = l.id AND m2.type = 'LOCKER' AND m2.status IS NULL) LEFT JOIN user_profiles up ON up.user_id = m.user_id
mapper.select: WHERE l.zone_id = #{zoneId} ORDER BY l.locker_number ASC
